annotation.bound_parties_text: The Regulation imposes obligations on manufacturers, authorised representatives, importers and distributors (economic operators) of UAS, Member States and market surveillance authorities, notified conformity assessment bodies, and third-country UAS operators.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Manufacturers shall ensure that the product is accompanied by the manual and information notice required by Parts 1 to 6 of the Annex
annotation.robot_provision_quote: COMMISSION DELEGATED REGULATION (EU) 2019/945 of 12 March 2019 on unmanned aircraft systems and on third-country operators of unmanned aircraft systems
